newsitem.title: CHINA: Salomon head plans Asian presentations this week.
newsitem.headline: Salomon head plans Asian presentations this week.

text.p: Salomon Inc chief executive Robert Denham will make presentations on asset-backed securitisations in four Asian cities this week, Salomon Brothers said on Monday.
"Asia is undergoing rapid economic growth," Denham said in a statement.
"I expect asset-backed securities will be a key component for infrastructure finance, consumer finance and small business finance in these Asian markets."
Denham is due to start his presentations in Manila on Tuesday in conjuction with the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) forum's Business Advisory Council.
Roberto Romulo, chairman of the Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co will host a luncheon with government officials before an afternoon briefing, it said.
Denham is scheduled to visit Jakarta on Wednesday, where he will be joined by Muchtar Mandala, president and chief executive of PT Bank Duta, Salomon Brothers said.
It said the presentations would continue in Bangkok on Thursday, hosted by Twatchai Yonkittikul, secretary-general of the Thai Bankers' Association.
The presentations will wrap up in Seoul on Friday, hosted by Jae Hyun Hyun, chairman of the Tong Yang Group, it said.
